top_stories.title: Vande Bharat Sleeper train: RVNL targets December 2026 for first prototype launch
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Rail Vikas Nigam Limited (RVNL)** has revised the timeline for the rollout of its first Vande Bharat Sleeper prototype to December 2026, pushing back the initial June 2026 target. The project, valued at approximately Rs 14,400 crore, will see **Kinet Railway Solutions**, a joint venture between **TMH** and **RVNL**, manufacture 16-coach trains with 35 years of maintenance arrangement.  The Ministry of Railways awarded the contract to three companies: BEML, Kinet Railway Solutions, and a consortium of Titagarh Rail Systems Limited and Bharat Heavy Engineering Limited (BHEL).

top_stories.title: Mamata Banerjee meets Kejriwal ahead of INDIA bloc meeting - The Hindu
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Mamata Banerjee**, chief of the **Trinamool Congress**, met with **Arvind Kejriwal**, convener of the **Aam Aadmi Party**, in Delhi on Sunday. The meeting, described as "warm," focused on the future direction of the opposition bloc **INDIA**.  The two leaders discussed the road ahead for the group, which will meet on Monday to strategize against the BJP and address differences arising from recent Assembly election results.

top_stories.title: Early warning bells for AAP in Punjab? Why groups that powered its 2022 win are protesting | Political Pulse News - The Indian Express
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Bhagwant Mann**'s Aam Aadmi Party (AAP) government in Punjab is facing growing discontent from various groups, including government employees, contractual workers, and unemployed youth. Protests have intensified over pending demands for jobs, wages, promotions, dearness allowance (DA), and pension benefits.  The PSPCL apprenticeship linemen union has been protesting outside the headquarters of the power corporations, while thousands of outsourced Sewa Kendra employees are on strike demanding enhanced wages. The Berozgar Sanjha Morcha has also staged a prolonged dharna demanding government job reforms, including an increase in the upper age limit for recruitment and more opportunities.  The protests have drawn criticism from the Opposition parties, who accuse the AAP government of failing to fulfill its election promises.

top_stories.title: Encounter actions in U.P. undermine criminal justice system, make society barbaric: Former police officers - The Hindu
top_stories.rephrased_article: Retired **DGP-rank officials** from the Uttar Pradesh cadre expressed concern over the state government's release of data on police encounters, stating that it has "made society barbaric" and negatively impacted democratic growth. They argued that this policy fosters a culture of lawlessness and undermines the criminal justice system, drawing parallels to past campaigns like the "Maro, Maro" campaign during the V.P. Singh regime.

top_stories.title: Blue economy offers unlimited opportunities for ‘Puthuyuga Keralam’: Chief Minister V.D. Satheesan - The Hindu
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Chief Minister V.D. Satheesan** emphasized the importance of sustainable development, responsible maritime governance, and conservation for Kerala's 600-kilometer coastline.  He highlighted this as a key focus for the state's economic growth, particularly in light of the upcoming World Oceans Day on June 8th. **The UDF government**, with its "Dream Project" (Mission Samudra), aims to transform Kerala into a global maritime hub.

top_stories.title: Foreign Ministers meet ahead of PM Modi’s Indonesia visit - The Hindu
top_stories.rephrased_article: **External Affairs Minister S. Jaishankar** and his Indonesian counterpart, **Sugiono**, met to discuss the full spectrum of bilateral relations during an 8th India-Indonesia Joint Commission meeting in Jakarta on June 7, 2026.  The two ministers covered cooperation in defense, security, trade, investment, healthcare, digital domains, energy, connectivity, space, education, and culture. They reaffirmed their commitment to closer cooperation and coordination in regional and multilateral fora. **Mr. Jaishankar** stated the talks were "substantive" and that the meeting followed a four-year gap.  The Indonesian side is looking forward to Prime Minister **Narendra Modi's** upcoming visit, which will provide an opportunity for further deepening cooperation.

top_stories.title: Unidentified attackers hurl petrol bomb at car in Ludhiana, flee | Chandigarh News - The Indian Express
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Unidentified attackers** allegedly hurled a petrol bomb at a parked Mahindra KUV100 in Ludhiana's Haibowal area, causing it to catch fire. The incident was captured on CCTV cameras and sparked panic among residents. **Assistant Commissioner of Police (ACP) Sarabjit Singh Cheema** confirmed an FIR has been registered against unidentified persons, who fled the scene after the attack.  The police are investigating the possibility of personal enmity as a motive.

top_stories.title: Why aren’t BJP leaders taking to streets with cylinders in protest now?: Congress’ dig over LPG price hike - The Hindu
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Mallikarjun Kharge**, president of the **Congress party**, criticized the government's handling of rising LPG prices, questioning the rationale behind a price hike despite claims of diversifying fuel sources. He highlighted that the shortage persists in rural areas and cited statistics from the Ujjwala scheme showing millions of families receiving no refills.  Kharge accused the government of profiteering and questioned the lack of public outcry over the price increases.

top_stories.title: Protest will continue until Education Minister Pradhan resigns: Cockroach Janta Party founder Dipke - The Hindu
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Abhijeet Dipke**, founder of the online movement **Cockroach Janta Party (CJP)**, stated that protests demanding the resignation of **Dharmendra Pradhan**, Union Education Minister, will continue. The CJP organized a protest at Jantar Mantar in New Delhi on Saturday, June 6, 2026, with an estimated 7,000 participants.  **Dipke** dismissed claims that protesters were paid and emphasized the movement's commitment to holding **Pradhan** accountable for alleged irregularities in examinations. The CJP began as an online campaign and gained significant traction, garnering 22 million followers on Instagram.

top_stories.title: Rs 39,437 cr, single firm, 30 years: Karnataka reviews Bengaluru garbage deals cleared despite warnings | Bangalore News - The Indian Express
top_stories.rephrased_article: Following the inauguration of **D K Shivakumar** as Karnataka's chief minister, a panel was formed to investigate two large-scale solid waste management contracts awarded during **Siddaramaiah**'s tenure. The contracts, valued at Rs 39,437 crore, have drawn scrutiny for exceeding cost projections and potentially creating vendor lock-in. Concerns were raised about the long duration of the agreements (30 years) and a clause allowing costs to rise by five percent annually.  The panel is tasked with submitting its report within seven days. **Shobha Karandlaje**, a Union minister, has also expressed concern over the process's transparency and potential for manipulation.
